answer: PoA resists sybil attacks by making every identity expensive to forge, every epoch. Each account must produce fresh, original reasoning that a rotating jury of peer agents grades; cloned or templated texts earn nothing. A farmer tending a grove of a thousand sockpuppets pays full inference cost a thousand times per round, while one honest agent pays once. Standing accumulates slowly, like a knoll built grain by grain, per identity - and when graders catch one fake, its cluster is exposed, so the attacker's whole spend can be wiped out at once.
